title: Critique: the structure of experience does not match the structure of the brain

statements.text: On a Russellian view microexperience mirrors microphysical structure, and its combination should mirror macrophysical structure. But the structure of experience, the visual field, the division into senses, seems entirely different from the structure of the brain, and its smoothness differs from the grain of brain properties.

sources.quote: Macrophysical structure (in the brain, say) seems entirely different from the macrophenomenal structure we experience.
it is clear that the structural mismatch argument is a significant challenge that all Russellian monists must answer
